messages.content: Hello! I'm doing great, thanks for asking. How can I assist you today?
I'm sorry, but I can't access your calendar at the moment. If you'd like, I can help you with something else or try again later.
Is there an event in my calendar today?
I'm sorry, I couldn't check your calendar right now. If you want, you can try opening your calendar app directly to take a look at your events for today.
